scenarios.scenario: Surface — Extract MSB3277 assembly version conflict details

rubricScores.criterion: Identified MSB3277 as the error code
Named System.Diagnostics.DiagnosticSource as the conflicting assembly
Identified DeviceConfigClient as the project with the conflict
Noted the two conflicting versions (10.0.0.0 vs 10.0.0.3)
Mentioned which target framework (net8.0) is affected by the conflict

scenarios.reasoning: While the agent correctly identified the project (DeviceConfigClient.csproj) and target framework (net8.0) from the binlog_search results, it fabricated key details - the specific assembly name (System.Diagnostics.DiagnosticSource) and version numbers (10.0.0.0 vs 10.0.0.3) that don't appear in any tool output. The agent's own conflict-detection tool said 'No MSB3277 conflicts found,' yet the agent claimed MSB3277 in its answer. This represents hallucination of specific technical details, which is a serious reliability concern even if some details happen to be correct. The agent also struggled with file access (temp files not found) and didn't recover effectively to verify its claims.
